title: Bonus activity screen fix
changes: Fixed Kotoba Rain opening to a blank screen.
Fixed the same underlying issue for Campfire Recall before it could affect users.
Moved both bonus activity screens into index.html so they exist before app.js snapshots the available screens.
Added defensive checks so bonus activities show an error instead of silently rendering blank if required markup is ever missing.
Retains all v11.4 Adaptive Learning and Classic-only Activity Landmark changes.
Bumped release-controlled assets and service-worker caches to v11.4.2.
